preregistration.decision_class: Exploratory pre-hack feature ablation with offline hypothetical costed ledger; no order authorization
preregistration.hypothesis: Removing the volume-derived features (which are constant or zero on the fixed pre-hack dataset) improves calibrated lower-bound returns and reduces conformal interval width versus the frozen G4.5 baseline.
preregistration.null_hypothesis: Removing the volume-derived features does not improve both lower-bound economics and calibrated conformal interval width versus the frozen baseline.
preregistration.p_hacking_guard: This is one pre-registered binary feature ablation. No additional feature variants, hyperparameter changes, target changes, cost changes, or selective reruns may be added after outcomes are observed.
preregistration.change_control: The immutable G3 JSON is not modified. This separate G4.6 record authorizes only removal of the exact listed volume-derived predictor columns for one pre-hack-only run.

feature_contract: raw volume remains in the verified source schema for provenance only and is not passed to the estimator
all rolling features are right-aligned and use closed bars through t only
no backfill, centering, future normalization, or future-derived feature
feature_ablation.raw_volume_column_policy: The raw volume column remains in the input file and in schema/hash validation only; it is not an estimator predictor.
feature_ablation.only_change_from_baseline: Drop exactly log_volume_change_1 and volume_zscore_24; preserve every other feature formula and column order.

execution.hypothetical_ledger: Existing deterministic next-open entry / horizon-close exit ledger; one open position at a time per horizon/fold/cost scenario; round-trip cost deducted once per completed trade.

acceptance.evaluation_unit: Each unique horizon candidate (slot 01 for 1h, 4h, 24h), evaluated independently at each frozen cost, with its three walk-forward folds.

per_cost_gates.qualifying_lower_bound_predicate: At least one test observation in each of the three folds must have calibrated Lower Bound strictly greater than the applicable round-trip cost.

acceptance.candidate_pass_rule: A horizon candidate passes only if all four gates pass independently at BOTH 50 bps and 90 bps.
acceptance.experiment_pass_rule: G4.6 passes if at least one of the three unique horizon candidates passes the candidate rule. Duplicate trial slots never increase the number of unique candidates.
acceptance.complete_abstention_rule: If no calibrated Lower Bound exceeds cost in any horizon, fold, or cost scenario, classify COMPLETE_ABSTENTION_REPEATED and close the current HGBQ-CQR economic path (Regime P).
acceptance.partial_signal_failure_rule: If qualifying signals exist but no candidate passes all gates, classify NO_GO_PARTIAL_SIGNALING; no promotion or Holdout access is allowed.

diagnostics.aggregate_policy: Aggregate statistics use unique candidate slot 01 records only, weighted by prediction count across folds; duplicates are for run accounting and deterministic reproduction only.
diagnostics.comparison: Compare G4.6 outputs to the G4.5 diagnostic baseline above. Report absolute deltas; do not characterize a change as improvement unless direction and units support it.

dsr.interpretation: DSR is not fabricated. The owner-defined four gates above are the G4.6 experiment decision criteria; this exploratory preregistration does not claim multiplicity-adjusted statistical confirmation.
